reason: Machine lens: every opcode is real 65SC12 (STX abs 8E, SBC/ORA/LDA imm, abs and abs,X; the 65C02 ones STZ/INC A/BRA were already there; section cmos = TRUE). The tables sky_rl..sky_rb are &BC90-&BCAD, so no indexed read crosses a page. Old cost: STA zp 3 + LDX# 2 + a non-final iteration of 64 (BRA DEA9->DE7D is on the same page) = 69. New peeled entry: 45 (SBC# 2, STA zp 3, 4x abs STA/STX at 4, 3x abs LDA at 4, 5 immediates at 2). Every later iteration drops SEC (-2), so the saving is 24 + 2m, where m (1-3) is the iterations left: n0 = H-L-1 with H 23/26/28 (sky_heights; sky_H comes only from type_ok's BNE path or from sky_h, which is stored only from sky_H when sky_on is set) and L 0-7, so n0 is 15-27. That gives 26 (n0<=16), 28 (17-24) or 30 (25-27) cycles an execution. The claimed 31.4 is above the 30 that is possible; it is presumably 20.4 / a rounded 0.65 executions, so the per-pass measurement can stand. The carry chain holds: SBC sky_t never borrows (H >= L+1); SBC #8 never borrows (n0 >= 15); after SBC #&02, C = 1 because rh is &40-&7F (AND #&3F / ORA #&40); loads and stores leave C. Bytes: +32 (37 new against 5 removed: STA zp, LDX#, SEC). Layout: .more DE7D->DE9E, .top DEAB->DECB; BCC top and BRA more stay inside page DE, and BRA's offset (-&2D) is in range. In the split loop, BNE whole, BCC whole and BNE split already crossed DE/DF and still do; BCS cross does not, before or after. All the relative distances there are unchanged. In sky_col_row and sky_col_check the branches now sit at DF47-DF83 and stay on page DF; hazel_b_end goes DF65->DF85, under the E000 ASSERT. sky_hazel has no self-modified operands, and nothing reads sky_geom as data (it is only JMPed to).
